title: Network now
description: Live state of the network from the stream: where vehicles are, how late lines and stops are by HSL's own estimate, and which vehicles have gone silent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS vehicles
FROM rt.vehicle_status
WHERE last_tst > now() - interval '60 seconds'

panels.title: Stale vehicles
panels.description: On a trip that has started and is still planned to run, silent for two minutes of event time. Vehicles silent before their trip starts are waiting, and vehicles whose trip has ended are finished; neither is counted.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS stale
FROM rt.vehicle_status
WHERE status = 'stale' AND last_tst > now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Suspect sign-ons
panels.description: Vehicles still reporting a journey whose planned end passed more than 15 minutes before their last report: usually a unit signed on to an old journey (coupled train units, a parked vehicle), sometimes a vehicle really running that late at the end of its trip.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS suspect
FROM rt.vehicle_status
WHERE suspect AND last_tst > now() - interval '5 minutes'

panels.title: Network median delay, last 5 min (live delay, HSL estimate)
panels.description: The median over every line's per-minute median in the last five minutes: the delay of a typical line, which a few vehicles reporting extreme values cannot move.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p50_live_delay_s))::numeric) AS delay
FROM rt.route_minute_stats
WHERE window_start > now() - interval '5 minutes'

panels.title: Newest minute closed
panels.description: How long ago the newest emitted per-minute window ended. A window closes once the watermark has passed its end plus ten seconds of allowed lateness; this grows when the aggregator falls behind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - max(window_start + interval '1 minute')) AS seconds
FROM rt.route_minute_stats
WHERE window_start > now() - interval '1 hour'

panels.title: Vehicles reporting in the last 60 seconds
panels.description: Last position of every vehicle that reported in the last 60 seconds.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.lat AS latitude,
       v.lon AS longitude,
       coalesce(r.route_short_name, v.route_id, '-') AS line,
       v.transport_mode AS mode,
       v.operator_id || '/' || v.vehicle_number AS vehicle,
       round(extract(epoch FROM now() - v.last_tst)) AS seconds_ago
FROM rt.vehicle_status AS v
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_routes AS r USING (route_id)
WHERE v.last_tst > now() - interval '60 seconds'
  AND v.lat IS NOT NULL AND v.lon IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Lines by delay, last 10 minutes (live delay, HSL estimate)
panels.description: Per line, from the per-minute event-time windows: HSL's own delay estimate carried in every message. Positive means late. Each minute stores the exact median and p90 over the journeys on the line, each journey counted once with its own median delay, so the coupled units of one train count once; the table shows the middle value of those over the last ten minutes. Journeys is the most journeys seen in one minute. Suspect sign-ons are left out.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(r.route_short_name, s.route_id) AS line,
       r.mode,
       max(s.minute_journeys) AS journeys,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.p50_live_delay_s))::numeric) AS median_delay_s,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.p90_live_delay_s))::numeric) AS p90_delay_s
FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(journeys) OVER (PARTITION BY route_id, window_start) AS minute_journeys
    FROM rt.route_minute_stats
    WHERE window_start > now() - interval '10 minutes'
) AS s
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_routes AS r USING (route_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING count(s.p50_live_delay_s) > 0
ORDER BY median_delay_s DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Median delay by mode (live delay, HSL estimate)
panels.description: Per minute and mode, the median over the lines' per-minute medians.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.window_start AS time,
       coalesce(r.mode, 'unknown') AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.p50_live_delay_s) AS delay
FROM rt.route_minute_stats AS s
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_routes AS r USING (route_id)
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.window_start) AND s.p50_live_delay_s IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Worst stops, last 15 minutes (live delay, HSL estimate)
panels.description: Stops with at least three arrivals in the last 15 minutes, by the median delay vehicles arrived with. As for lines, each minute stores the exact median and p90, and the table shows the middle value of those over the last 15 minutes.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT d.stop_code AS stop,
       d.stop_name AS name,
       sum(s.arrivals) AS arrivals,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.p50_live_delay_s))::numeric) AS median_delay_s,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY s.p90_live_delay_s))::numeric) AS p90_delay_s
FROM rt.stop_minute_stats AS s
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_stops AS d USING (stop_id)
WHERE s.window_start > now() - interval '15 minutes' AND s.p50_live_delay_s IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.stop_id, 1, 2
HAVING sum(s.live_delay_samples) >= 3
ORDER BY median_delay_s DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Stale vehicles: silent while their trip is planned to run
panels.description: Vehicles that stopped reporting for two minutes of event time after their trip's planned start and before its planned end, in the last hour. Vehicles silent before the start are waiting, those past the end finished; neither is shown. A trip missing from the timetable has no planned end; such a vehicle stays stale and drops off after an hour.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.operator_id || '/' || v.vehicle_number AS vehicle,
       coalesce(r.route_short_name, v.route_id) AS line,
       v.transport_mode AS mode,
       v.start_time AS trip_start,
       v.silent_since,
       round(extract(epoch FROM now() - v.last_tst) / 60) AS minutes_silent,
       v.planned_end
FROM rt.vehicle_status AS v
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_routes AS r USING (route_id)
WHERE v.status = 'stale' AND v.last_tst > now() - interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY v.silent_since

panels.title: Suspect sign-ons: reporting a journey that should have ended
panels.description: Vehicles still reporting a journey whose planned end passed more than 15 minutes before their last report: usually a unit signed on to an old journey (coupled train units, a parked vehicle), sometimes a vehicle really running that late at the end of its trip. Their positions are on the map; their delays are left out of every delay figure on this dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT v.operator_id || '/' || v.vehicle_number AS vehicle,
       coalesce(r.route_short_name, v.route_id) AS line,
       v.transport_mode AS mode,
       v.start_time AS trip_start,
       v.planned_end,
       round(extract(epoch FROM v.last_tst - v.planned_end) / 60) AS minutes_past_end
FROM rt.vehicle_status AS v
LEFT JOIN marts.dim_routes AS r USING (route_id)
WHERE v.suspect AND v.last_tst > now() - interval '5 minutes'
ORDER BY minutes_past_end DESC
